agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario violates pole_upright at step 17 with theta -0.81 rad (limit 0.8). Trace shows monotonic divergence from initial theta 0.1: theta grows negative to -0.15 at step10, -0.48 at step14, -0.589 at step15, -0.698 at step16, -0.81 at step17, with omega accelerating to -5.7 rad/s. Sensor_noise 0.0081 corrupts angle measurement; with large dt 0.01987 (near 0.02 limit) controller samples stale noisy state once per outer step and applies incorrectly signed/magnitude force, failing to arrest fall despite force well below limit (0.15N vs 42.5N limit). Removing noise stabilizes.
